notes: Distributed, physically based watershed-scale model coupling hydrology with ecosystem carbon/nutrient cycling.
Coupled/standalone versions exist; full source access requires a request through the official site's contact page rather than an open public repo.

Developed within the CTSM (Community Terrestrial Systems Model) codebase. Version distinctions matter: stomatal conductance scheme differs materially between CLM4.5 (Ball-Berry-type) and CLM5.0 (Medlyn optimality-based) -- see model_versions.csv.
Source code available on request from Lund University rather than an open public repository.
